markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (77%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
Invasive probability is under 1%, but InSitu (21%) stays in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 77%, InSitu 21% | Clear lead, real runner-up |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.95 / 90th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous nearest neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · strongest benign-side association; spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 2, 3, 6) · context · above typical here; spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · above typical; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · supports benign tissue; spot check 20/20 · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · runs against the suggestion; spot check 19/20 · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region removal drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu is the true class; the conformal set cannot exclude it.
- Concept scores mislead: normal lobules and mitoses failed spot checks.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 3**: look for atypical cells confined within ducts; InSitu remains possible.
2. **Region 4**: tumor-infiltrating stroma peaks here; confirm no invasive focus.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: check whether mitoses are real; spot check failed.
